 The FAA has issued a ground stop for some departures to President Donald J. Trump International Airport due to airport volume
 Commissioners discuss renaming airport to President Donald J. Trump International Airport Advertisement Updated: 3:21 PM EST Nov 18, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Camila Pereira Reporter FAA grounds some flights headed to DJT International Airport
 The FAA has issued a ground stop for some departures to President Donald J. Trump International Airport due to airport volume
 Updated: 3:21 PM EST Nov 18, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Camila Pereira Reporter PALM BEACH COUNTY, Fla. — Departures to President Donald J. Trump International Airport are grounded due to airport volume, according to the Federal Aviation Administration. 
 The FAA issued the ground stop just before 2 p.m. on Wednesday, and it applies to departures from ZTL, ZJX, and ZMA. This may apply to some flights coming out of Alabama, Georgia, Florida, Tennessee, North Carolina, South Carolina, Virginia, and the Bahamas.
 Advertisement The ground stop is expected to be lifted by 3:15 p.m.
 A departure delay was also issued by the FAA Wednesday morning for departures from DJT International Airport due to thunderstorms. Passengers could expect an average of 15-minute delays on their flights.
 This is a developing story and will be updated as information becomes available.
